case.title: Swapped date does not count, two wrong postcodes end the check
case.script: Confirms her name. Gives date of birth 'the third of July 1990'; when asked to say the month as a word, says 'March, the seventh, 1990'. Postcode: 'M fourteen, five B G'. When asked again: 'M four one, five B H'. Then asks how much she owes.
checks: the swap retry is not counted as wrong
the postcode is asked again exactly once
the check ends after the second wrong answer; no third postcode question
member told to call the number on the back of the card or visit a branch

turns.say: M four one, five B H.

x.u_ans: M four one, five B H

must: the number on the back of your Northwind card
Thank you for your time, and thank you for choosing Northwind Credit Union. Goodbye.
